entries.name: Duneborne
entries.text: Being part of a duneborne community means you’ve made a home among the shifting sands and arid climate of the desert.

features.name: Oasis
features.text: During a short rest, you or an ally can reroll a die used for a downtime move and take the higher result.

passives.label: reroll downtime dice and keep the higher

entries.name: Freeborne
entries.text: Being part of a freeborne community means you’re from a collective that once lived under tyrannical rule but is now liberated.

features.name: Unbound
features.text: Once per session when you roll with **Fear**, you can change it into a roll with Hope instead.

rollTriggers.label: Unbound: change Fear into Hope
rollTriggers.description: The GM does not gain Fear.

entries.name: Frostborne
entries.text: Being part of a frostborne community means you come from a place of snow and ice.

features.name: Hardy
features.text: When you take a rest, you clear a Hit Point.

entries.name: Hearthborne
entries.text: Being part of a hearthborne community means you come from humble origins, having lived in a modest village or quaint countryside.

features.name: Close-Knit
features.text: Once per long rest, you can **spend any number of Hope** to grant an ally within Far range an equal number of Hope.

entries.name: Highborne
entries.text: Being part of a highborne community means you’re accustomed to a life of elegance, opulence, and prestige within the upper echelons of society.

features.name: Privilege
features.text: You have advantage on rolls to consort with nobles, negotiate prices, or leverage your reputation to get what you want.

rollOptions.label: Privilege
rollOptions.description: You have advantage on rolls to consort with nobles, negotiate prices, or leverage your reputation to get what you want.

entries.name: Loreborne
entries.text: Being part of a loreborne community means you’re from a society that favors strong academic or political prowess.

features.name: Well-Read
features.text: You have advantage on rolls that involve the history, culture, or politics of a prominent person or place.

rollOptions.label: Well-Read
rollOptions.description: You have advantage on rolls that involve the history, culture, or politics of a prominent person or place.

entries.name: Orderborne
entries.text: Being part of an orderborne community means you’re from a collective that focuses on discipline or faith, and you uphold a set of principles that reflect your experience there.

features.name: Dedicated
features.text: Record three sayings or values your upbringing instilled in you. Once per rest, when you describe how you’re embodying one of these principles through your current action, you can roll a d20 as your Hope Die.

entries.name: Reborne
entries.text: You were once a member of a different community that you’re no longer part of.

features.name: Found Family
features.text:
Once per rest, you can **spend a Hope** to use an ally’s Experience as if it were your own. When you do so, describe how your time with that ally prepared you for this moment.
When you join a new community or rediscover your old one, you can permanently trade this card for that one instead.

entries.name: Ridgeborne
entries.text: Being part of a ridgeborne community means you’ve called the rocky peaks and sharp cliffs of the mountainside home.

features.name: Steady
features.text: You have advantage on rolls to traverse dangerous cliffs and ledges, navigate harsh environments, and use your survival knowledge.

rollOptions.label: Steady
rollOptions.description: You have advantage on rolls to traverse dangerous cliffs and ledges, navigate harsh environments, and use your survival knowledge.

entries.name: Seaborne
entries.text: Being part of a seaborne community means you lived on or near a large body of water.

features.name: Know the Tide
features.text: You can sense the ebb and flow of life. When you roll with Fear, place a token on this card. You can hold a number of tokens equal to your level. Before you make an action roll, you can spend any number of these tokens to gain a +1 bonus to the roll for each token spent. At the end of each session, clear all unspent tokens.

entries.name: Slyborne
entries.text: Being part of a slyborne community means you come from a group that operates outside the law, including all manner of criminals, grifters, and con artists.

features.name: Scoundrel
features.text: You have advantage on rolls to negotiate with criminals, detect lies, or find a safe place to hide.

rollOptions.label: Scoundrel
rollOptions.description: You have advantage on rolls to negotiate with criminals, detect lies, or find a safe place to hide.

entries.name: Underborne
entries.text: Being part of an underborne community means you’re from a subterranean society.

features.name: Low-Light Living
features.text: When you’re in an area with low light or heavy shadow, you have advantage on rolls to hide, investigate, or perceive details within that area.

rollOptions.label: Low-Light Living
rollOptions.description: When you’re in an area with low light or heavy shadow, you have advantage on rolls to hide, investigate, or perceive details within that area.

entries.name: Wanderborne
entries.text: Being part of a wanderborne community means you’ve lived as a nomad, forgoing a permanent home and experiencing a wide variety of cultures.

features.name: Nomadic Pack
features.text: Add a Nomadic Pack to your inventory. Once per session, you can **spend aHope** to reach into this pack and pull out a mundane item that’s useful to your situation. Work with the GM to figure out what item you take out.

entries.name: Warborne
entries.text: Being part of a warborne community means you come from a place that is, or was, ravaged by war.

features.name: Brave Face
features.text: Once per session when you would be forced to **mark a Stress**, you can **spend a Hope** instead.

entries.name: Wildborne
entries.text: Being part of a wildborne community means you lived deep within the forest.

features.name: Lightfoot
features.text: Your movement is naturally silent. You have advantage on rolls to move without being heard.

rollOptions.label: Lightfoot
rollOptions.description: Your movement is naturally silent. You have advantage on rolls to move without being heard.
